:''Not to be confused with either [[Militia captain]]s or the [[Captain of the guard]]''

'''Captain''' is a position in the mostly unrealized civilization-wide dwarven army, acting as leader of a squad of ten soldiers. A captain is appointed by the [[General]] and commanded by a [[Lieutenant]].
